doc: Bilingual reply payload as a model returns it (translation + replies[{text, zh}] + lang + analysis) -> the parsed result. Rules: the payload is the outermost {...} in the text (prose and code fences around it are ignored); a reply is an object {text, zh} or a bare string; blank / null texts are dropped and each kept text keeps ITS OWN gloss; at most 3 replies; every string is trimmed; missing fields are empty strings. Failure messages are fixed text and never contain any of the model's output (it may quote the chat back). Platform extensions (Android also reads 'relations') are outside v1.

errors.bad_json: 模型返回的 JSON 无法解析
errors.no_replies: 模型没有给出候选回复

cases.name: plain payload
cases.content: {"lang":"德语","analysis":"寒暄","translation":"你最近怎么样","replies":[{"text":"Gut, danke!","zh":"挺好，谢谢"},{"text":"Alles klar.","zh":"都好"},{"text":"Und dir?","zh":"你呢"}]}

cases.name: code fence and prose around the payload
more than three replies keeps the first three
bare string replies are accepted, no gloss
missing zh is an empty gloss
blank text is dropped and the gloss stays with its own reply
null text is dropped, never the word null
no json in the text
